info.title: Freya Bank final case fixture mock
info.description: Seven POST services grounded in the immutable 2026-10-01 service contract sections 3–6 and test-customers.json. Test mode ignores Authorization, Content-Type/Accept validation, call metadata and aiFlow. All date decisions in the phone agent use supplied now; mock dates remain exactly as the fixed fixtures. Parent must replace servers[0].url with the deployed public origin in HOSTCONFIG before builder execution.
